verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers JQL (JavaScript Query Language), an in-platform query engine that lets developers write custom code (main() function) to query raw event data, plus a Query API for filtering/breaking down events and cohorts — functioning as Mixpanel's SQL-equivalent query layer inside the platform. missing for 10: true SQL syntax support, evidence JQL is actively maintained (it appears legacy) and independent/hands-on corroboration of using JQL for raw event queries.
